project_info.industry: Pengelola & Pengangkut Limbah B3 (Hazardous Waste Management & Logistics)

project_info.tagline: Pelopor Pengelolaan Limbah B3 Terpadu, Berizin & Berkelanjutan di Indonesia

design_archetype.name: Organic & Tech Teal (Awwwards SOTD Cleantech)
design_archetype.vibe: Lingkungan Banget, Bersih, Modern Casual & High-Precision Engineering
design_archetype.theme_mode: Dual theme support (Default Light Clean Eco with Dark Slate High-Contrast accents & Admin Dark Mode)

fonts.accent_mono: JetBrains Mono / Space Mono (for manifest numbers, permits, GPS codes, dates)

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-50
scale.small_label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-400 font-medium

header.style: Glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-teal-100/50 z-50)

page_structure.hero_section: Kinetic Hero with masked line-by-line headline reveal, status badges, real background imagery, and impact stats grid
page_structure.editorial_marquee: Slow drifting ticker ribbon showcasing KLHK Permits, ISO 14001, Festronik Integrated, 100% Zero-Leak Guarantee
page_structure.manifesto_chapters: Numbered 01-03 chapters for Visi, Misi, and Nilai Perusahaan with side-by-side interactive toggle
page_structure.armada_layanan_section: Interactive tabs comparing Fleet Types (Wingbox, Tanker, Dump Truck, ISO Tank) and B3 Waste Categories
page_structure.legalitas_grid: Official permits card grid with searchable document codes, issuing body (KLHK/Kemenhub), and download request CTA
page_structure.coverage_map: Interactive Indonesia coverage map highlight (Jawa, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi) with operational hubs
page_structure.gallery_grid: Filterable gallery (Fasilitas, Fleet, Operations, CSR & Safety)
page_structure.news_section: Editorial news grid with search, categories, and detail modal/page
page_structure.whatsapp_floating: Floating bottom-right green pulse button with instant pre-filled chat message
page_structure.footer: Multi-column layout with HQ address in Cikarang Industrial Area, KLHK License info, direct contacts, socials, and quick inquiry form

key_features_and_components.kinetic_hero_reveal: Framer Motion staggered text mask revealing line by line with spring animation on load
key_features_and_components.manifest_tracker_widget: Interactive widget where client can enter Festronik B3 Manifest Code to check real-time disposal status

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, filters, tabs, menu items, modals) contain explicit data-testid attributes.
Do NOT center-align main paragraph content or body blocks. Use left-aligned editorial layout with generous padding.
Use Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll triggers.
Support full SEO meta tags (title, meta description, keywords, Open Graph, JSON-LD structured data for Company/Organization) in index.html and React Helmet / Page SEO wrapper.
Ensure seamless Bahasa Indonesia terminology (e.g., SIMPEL KLHK, Festronik, Limbah B3, Karakteristik Limbah, Manifest, Transporter Berizin).
Keep floating WhatsApp CTA accessible on all client pages with custom pre-filled inquiry text.
